description: Java class implementing a service for importing notification templates in the Thingsboard platform, extending base entity import functionality.

classes.name: NotificationTemplateImportService
classes.description: Service class for importing NotificationTemplate entities, extending base import service.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the tenant ID owner for the notification template.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the notification template for import, currently returns the input as-is.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Validates and saves or updates the notification template.

methods.name: onEntitySaved
methods.description: Logs the action of saving or updating the entity.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the notification template.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE.
